verdict.rationale: Docs describe act()/observe()/extract() as natural-language, DOM-understanding primitives with selfHeal to re-infer broken selectors and automatic iframe/shadow-DOM handling, directly matching the story; independent HN commentary corroborates that Stagehand dynamically regenerates Playwright actions making it resilient to DOM changes. Missing for 10: rigorous independent benchmark of resilience across real layout changes and more than a single third-party account.
